# Packet — king-list-akkad: Sargon and the kings of Akkad (VI 31 – VII 14)

Langdon 1923, his transliteration as printed (accents kept; convert to modern subscript indices by SIGN, not by arithmetic — e.g. his dé is the NE sign, de₃). Langdon's [ ] = restored; marks/notes from the transcription are given per line. Read every sign on the plate.

## Images (source/pages/)

- transliteration pages: langdon1923_0022.jpg, langdon1923_0023.jpg
- plates: langdon1923_0044.jpg, langdon1923_0045.jpg (Pl. III, Pl. IV)
- the published part king-list-antediluvian.json is the model of shape, notation and register

## Lines (col · line · Langdon · confidence · note)

VI 31	A-ga-dé Šar-ru-ki-in-	high	— Name runs over the line break: Šar-ru-ki-in- / -ì-lu-ba-ni.
VI 32	-ì-lu-ba-ni nu-giš-šar	high	— Continuation of the name from line 31.
VI 33	ka-šu-duĝ Ur-ᵈIl-ba-ba	high	— duĝ: g printed with a diacritic above (Langdon's nasal g). fn 1: here begins Legrain No. 1 VII.
VI 34	lugal A-ga-de (ki) galu A-ga-de-(ki)	high	— Langdon prints 'A-ga-de (ki)' (space, no hyphen) and de (not dé) in both names here.
VI 35	mu- un- dū- a	high	— Spaced 'mu-  un-   dū-  a'. Translation column blank.

VI 48	[mu 24 (?) ni- ag]	low	— Restored with '(?)'. fn 10: so clearly L. No. 1 VII 17; Poebel No. 3 R. II 4 has 24. Last line of Col. VI (48).	[restored, uncertain]
VII 1	[a-ba-ám lugal] a-ba-ám nu lugal	high	— First half restored. fn 11: so also S. Rev. 2; P. No. 3 Rev. II 7 has Semitic ma-nu-um šarru ma-nu-um la šarru.	[restored]
VII 2	[I-gí-]gí lugal	high	— Beginning restored. fn 12: variants ì-gi-gi / ì-ki-ki.	[restored]

VII 4	[Na-ni] lugal	high	— Name restored. fn 13: S. Rev. 4 and L. No. 1 VII 21 na-nu-um.	[restored]

VII 6	4 lugal	high	— fn 15: for lines 6-7, P. No. 3 Rev. 13 and S. Rev. 5 have 4-bi 3 mu ib(in)-ag.
VII 7	[mu 3 ] ib- ag	high	— mu 3 restored.	[restored]

VII 10	[mu] 15 ni- ag	high	— mu restored.	[restored]
